title: On the defect in the generalized Grunwald--Wang problem
summary: The classical Grunwald--Wang theorem asserts that, unless we are in the so-called special case, local cyclic Galois extensions at finitely many completions of a number field can be approximated by a global cyclic extension. In the special case the obstruction is measured by a group of order 2. It has been known for a long time that the Grunwald--Wang theorem extends to a very general context of valued fields.
